name: flow-codeblock
description: Manage, validate, publish, and execute Flow Codeblock scripts through a local stdio MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Manage and execute Flow Codeblock scripts
interface.longDescription: Flow Codeblock provides local stdio MCP tools and a Skill for non-script authoring and execution, script inspection, interface-document generation, preview-and-confirm changes, ownership management, and code execution in an isolated Web worker lane. The plugin provides no script-deletion or token-management tool.
defaultPrompt: Get my Flow Codeblock token and scripts
Preview and confirm a script and interface-document update
Execute a Flow Codeblock script and inspect statistics
